Echo (Class I Spirit).summary: A psychic recording of a traumatic death, repeating endlessly. Cannot be negotiated with.
Echo (Class I Spirit).lore: Not truly a spirit, but an imprint. Requires a witness to speak the truth of the event to fade.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Replay the death
sb_spends.effect: The Echo projects its death into a PC's mind; they mark 1 Fatigue unless they speak a truth aloud.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Strengthen the imprint
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Imprint Deepens' timer. When full, a second Echo spawns from the same site.

Echo (Class I Spirit).harm_levels: None (puzzle) — resolved by witness, not violence.

Anchor (Class II Spirit).summary: A spirit bound to an object, location, or person by unresolved emotion. Possesses will and memory.
Anchor (Class II Spirit).lore: Can be negotiated with to fulfill unfinished business.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Offer a fragment of memory
sb_spends.effect: The Anchor offers a useful memory if a PC swears to fulfill its unfinished business.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Ride the bound object
sb_spends.effect: The Anchor possesses its anchor-object; anyone touching it sees the Anchor's death and is Slowed.

Poltergeist (Class III Spirit).summary: A corrupted Anchor, driven by rage or hunger. A wound that has learned to strike back.
locations: The Plague House of Port Shed
Poltergeist (Class III Spirit).lore: Progresses through stages from The Knock to The Mask (possession).

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Throw the room
sb_spends.effect: Furniture, debris, or tools fly at the party; one PC is knocked Prone.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Manifest the scream
sb_spends.effect: The Poltergeist becomes visible; all PCs in Near range mark 1 Fatigue from its shriek.

sb_spends.name: [POSSESSION] The Mask forms
sb_spends.effect: The Poltergeist rides a host for one exchange, turning their body against the party.

Ghoul (Starved Anchor).summary: An Anchor that has begun consuming life force to sustain itself. Retains intelligence.
Ghoul (Starved Anchor).lore: Can be negotiated with if fed; fire and silver are key weaknesses.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Hunger speaks
sb_spends.effect: The Ghoul pauses, offering information in exchange for a morsel of flesh or a recent memory.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Call another starved mouth
sb_spends.effect: Its hunger-song draws a second Starved Anchor from a dark corner.

sb_spends.name: [BLOOD] Latching bite
sb_spends.effect: The Ghoul fastens onto a PC; the PC marks Harm 1 and the Ghoul heals.

Linn Sea-Wolf (Lycanthrope).summary: A lycanthrope that transforms into a massive seal or walrus. Solitary and melancholic.
Linn Sea-Wolf (Lycanthrope).lore: Transforms during the first winter storm after a kill. Vulnerable to silver.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Drag into the surf
sb_spends.effect: The Sea-Wolf hauls a PC into freezing water; they are Slowed until warmed.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Storm-sibling
sb_spends.effect: The storm's voice calls a second Sea-Wolf from the breakers.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Drowning tide
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Tide Rises' timer. When full, the surf sweeps the lowest ground clear.

Ykrul Sky-Hound (Lycanthrope).summary: A hawk-headed hunter that transforms during the day to hunt oath-breakers.
Ykrul Sky-Hound (Lycanthrope).lore: Triggered by the sight of blood on fresh snow. Hunts for justice, not flesh.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Circle the oath-breaker
sb_spends.effect: The Sky-Hound circles a PC it judges guilty; other PCs must choose to intervene or condemn.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Mark of judgment
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Judgment' timer. At 4, the Sky-Hound strikes the marked PC.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Screaming snow
sb_spends.effect: Its cry kicks up blinding snow; vision in Near is reduced to one exchange.

Valewood Root-Walker (Lycanthrope).summary: Transforms into a tree, immobile but all-seeing. Guardians, not predators.
Valewood Root-Walker (Lycanthrope).lore: Triggered by a witnessed promise of hospitality.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Demand hospitality
sb_spends.effect: It will not allow passage until a PC swears a promise of hospitality.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Roots seize the path
sb_spends.effect: Roots erupt across the ground; movement in the area becomes Desperate.

sb_spends.name: [FEY] Witness a broken promise
sb_spends.effect: If a PC breaks a promise in its grove, it transforms into a Thorn Dryad's vassal and attacks.

Aeler Stone-Hide (Lycanthrope).summary: Massive, slow lycanthrope that transforms only underground. Nearly invulnerable.
Aeler Stone-Hide (Lycanthrope).lore: Cannot transform in sunlight. Silver weapon to the heart or brain.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Cavern-shaking slam
sb_spends.effect: It slams the stone; start a 4-segment 'Collapse' timer. At 4, rocks fall in the chamber.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Stone dust cloud
sb_spends.effect: It kicks up thick stone-dust; all attacks in Near are Desperate until cleared.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Pressure-crack ally
sb_spends.effect: The tremor cracks a wall and a Vein-Serpent spills out to aid it.

Baron Quentin Asselin (True Vampire).summary: The first vampire and one of the Thirteen. Disillusioned and melancholic.
locations: A secluded estate in a remote valley
Baron Quentin Asselin (True Vampire).lore: Converts guests or drives them mad. Never accept his wine.

sb_spends.name: [BLOOD] Lock eyes
sb_spends.effect: The Baron catches a PC's gaze; they must test Spirit + Resolve or offer a wrist.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Offer the wine
sb_spends.effect: He offers a drink. Refusing worsens all party Position by one step for this scene.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Call the household
sb_spends.effect: A lesser vampire or two enthralled servants arrive from the wine cellar.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Mist and memory
sb_spends.effect: He dissolves into mist and reforms behind a PC, whispering their greatest failure.

Sister Maris (True Vampire).summary: One of the Thirteen. Runs a children's hospice where the children never leave.
Sister Maris (True Vampire).lore: The Everflame has tried to destroy her hospice four times, but the children defend her.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] The children sing
sb_spends.effect: The children form a protective ring; harming Sister Maris requires harming them first.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Mother's mercy
sb_spends.effect: She offers to heal a PC's Harm if they swear never to harm her.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Wake the hospice
sb_spends.effect: More children rise from their beds, moving with wrong, shared grace.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Lullaby of forgetting
sb_spends.effect: She sings; PCs in Near must test Spirit or lose a Boon and forget why they came.

The Sparrow (True Vampire).summary: One of the Thirteen. Kills only the wicked, or so he claims.
The Sparrow (True Vampire).lore: Cannot look at mirrors. Has saved Saikou Ira's life twice.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Name the wicked
sb_spends.effect: He declares one PC 'wicked'; the others must justify them or he attacks that PC.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] A life for a secret
sb_spends.effect: He offers to spare a target if the party gives up a secret that will ruin someone.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Shatter every mirror
sb_spends.effect: He breaks reflective surfaces in Near; no one can use them against him.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Step from shadow
sb_spends.effect: He appears in a PC's shadow and strikes before they can act.

Linn Draugr (Lesser Vampire).summary: Vampires that breathe underwater, trapped by sea-salt circles.
Linn Draugr (Lesser Vampire).lore: A lesser bloodline of the Thirteen.

sb_spends.name: [BLOOD] Feed on the drowned
sb_spends.effect: It drags a nearby corpse underwater and feeds, healing itself.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Salt wash
sb_spends.effect: It splashes salt water, eroding a protective circle or weakening a barrier.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Call from the wreck
sb_spends.effect: Its cry rouses another Draugr tangled in the kelp.

Aeler Stone-Sleepers (Lesser Vampire).summary: Vampires that drink breath, awakened by bronze bells at dawn.

sb_spends.name: [BLOOD] Steal a breath
sb_spends.effect: It sips the air from a PC's lungs; they mark 1 Fatigue.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Extinguish light
sb_spends.effect: It snuffs the nearest flame or lantern, claiming the darkness.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] The bronze bell rings
sb_spends.effect: A distant bell tolls and another Stone-Sleeper opens its eyes.

Ykrul Bone-Eaters (Lesser Vampire).summary: Vampires that turn to dust when killed but rise if their name is spoken.
Ykrul Bone-Eaters (Lesser Vampire).lore: Erase the name to destroy them permanently.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Speak the name
sb_spends.effect: A PC or NPC accidentally speaks its name; it reforms from dust.

sb_spends.name: [BLOOD] Crunch marrow
sb_spends.effect: It devours a bone it carries, healing and gaining one die next exchange.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Name-stealing curse
sb_spends.effect: It bites a PC and learns their true name; the PC's Position worsens until they reclaim it.

Vhasian Candle-Wights (Lesser Vampire).summary: Vampires that extinguish flames through windows. A lit candle at the threshold bars them.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Blow out the light
sb_spends.effect: It extinguishes one light source in Near or Far range.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Tap at the glass
sb_spends.effect: It appears at a window; PCs inside must test Spirit or lose a Boon.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Candle wanes
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Threshold Light' timer. At 4, the last protective candle goes out.

Lethai-ar Silk-Drinkers (Lesser Vampire).summary: Vampires that feed on desire. Vulnerable to vows witnessed by a third party.
locations: The Court Painter of Mbaro's domain

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Offered wish
sb_spends.effect: It whispers a PC's desire and offers it if they break a vow.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Unwanted truth
sb_spends.effect: It drinks a secret and speaks it aloud, turning allies against each other.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Hunger blooms
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Longing' timer. At 4, a PC is compelled to approach it.

The Oath-Keeper (Possessor Variant).summary: A spirit of broken oaths that wears the face of the person you failed.
The Oath-Keeper (Possessor Variant).lore: Manifests from your own memory. It accuses, does not attack. Can possess a host.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Name the broken oath
sb_spends.effect: It speaks the oath aloud; the accused PC's Position worsens until they answer.

sb_spends.name: [POSSESSION] Wear the host
sb_spends.effect: It enters a host's shadow; the PC speaks truths they wanted hidden.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Public reckoning
sb_spends.effect: It forces a confrontation; all present must choose a side, splitting the party.

The Oath-Keeper (Possessor Variant).harm_levels: None. Unkillable — a puzzle of payment and confession, not a fight.

The Misstep.summary: A ghost that rises where a threshold is crossed wrongly—nine steps taken where eight were asked, a door opened out of turn.
The Misstep.lore: Can only be resolved by walking the threshold as it should be walked. It claims a memory from those who cross out of turn.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Threshold unravels
sb_spends.effect: Tick 'Threshold Unraveling' +1. At 4, the doorway leads somewhere else entirely.

sb_spends.name: [MEMORY] Claim a step
sb_spends.effect: The Misstep takes a memory; a PC forgets why they entered this room.

The Weeping Shade.summary: A ghost bound by a secret promise of silence, unable to speak its unfinished business.
The Weeping Shade.lore: Can only be resolved by someone speaking the secret aloud in the presence of a witness.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Press the secret
sb_spends.effect: It pushes a secret into a PC's mind; they must share it or mark 1 Fatigue.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Speak for me
sb_spends.effect: It offers to reveal a hidden door if a PC swears to carry its message to the living.

The Weeping Shade.harm_levels: None (puzzle) — can only be named, not fought.

The Unwitnessed Door.summary: A threshold entity that appears as a gray door where no door stood before.
The Unwitnessed Door.lore: Opens to a room with two mirrors. Choosing one transforms the character.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] A second door
sb_spends.effect: A second gray door appears; choosing wrongly transforms a random trait.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Doors begin to fade
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Door Closes' timer. At 4, both doors vanish and the party is stranded.

The Unwitnessed Door.harm_levels: None (puzzle) — there is no combat, only a choice.

The Deep Drake (Pressure that Thinks).summary: A mythic creature dwelling in the deepest galleries beneath Khaz-Vurim.
locations: The Heart of the Ninth Gallery
The Deep Drake (Pressure that Thinks).lore: A wyrm, child of Nidhoggr. It invites intruders to count their breaths, then consumes them.

sb_spends.name: [PRESSURE] Count your breaths
sb_spends.effect: The Drake counts aloud; all PCs in Near must hold their breath or mark 1 Fatigue.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Crush of the deep
sb_spends.effect: Start a 6-segment 'Gallery Collapse' timer. At 6, the stone closes like a fist.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Pressure-spawn
sb_spends.effect: A fissure opens and Nidhoggr's Brood spills through to flank the party.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Exhale stale air
sb_spends.effect: The Drake exhales pressure; all ranged attacks in Near become Desperate.

The Deep Drake (Pressure that Thinks).harm_levels: 8 per phase (multi-phasic); four phases (The Counting, The Hungry Thought, The Uncoiling, The Ninth Breath), Mythic-tier.

Whisperer (Imp - Rank I Demon).summary: A demon of small bargains, offering power through contracts witnessed by no one.
Whisperer (Imp - Rank I Demon).lore: A contract sealed without a third party is a hole shaped like your own hand.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Whisper a contract
sb_spends.effect: It offers a small power for a tiny, unwitnessed promise.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Find a witness
sb_spends.effect: It points out that a PC's deal lacks a witness; the PC loses a Boon until they find one.

Whisperer (Imp - Rank I Demon).harm_levels: None while possessing (puzzle) — removed by naming and witness, not Harm.

Ravager (Fury - Rank II Demon).summary: A demon summoned by violence or mass death. It does not speak; it erases.
Ravager (Fury - Rank II Demon).lore: Banishment requires overwhelming witness—three or more souls refusing to look away.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Erase the ground
sb_spends.effect: Its passage scorches earth; movement in Near becomes Desperate.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Birth from slaughter
sb_spends.effect: The blood of the wounded births a second, lesser Ravager.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Refuse to witness
sb_spends.effect: It forces a PC to avert their eyes; that PC cannot assist others this exchange.

Ravager (Fury - Rank II Demon).harm_levels: None while possessing (puzzle) — banished by overwhelming witness, not Harm.

Possessor (Marquis - Rank III Demon).summary: A demon that possesses a host, slowly eroding their identity.
locations: Where a soul has said 'yes' to something they should have refused
Possessor (Marquis - Rank III Demon).lore: Exorcism requires a witness from the host's faith and the demon's true name.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Offer to leave
sb_spends.effect: It whispers that it will depart the host if the party sacrifices someone else's name.

sb_spends.name: [POSSESSION] Leap to a new host
sb_spends.effect: It abandons the current host and seizes a nearby NPC or PC.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Erode the self
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Identity Fades' timer. At 4, the host forgets their own name.

Possessor (Marquis - Rank III Demon).harm_levels: None while possessing (puzzle) — removed by argued exorcism, not Harm.

Parasite (Duke - Rank IV Demon).summary: A demon that embodies an emotion: fear, grief, or ambition, starving the body.
Parasite (Duke - Rank IV Demon).lore: Countered by rigorous emotional discipline and sensory deprivation.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Amplify the feeling
sb_spends.effect: It feasts on a PC's dominant emotion; that PC acts at Desperate Position.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Take the pain
sb_spends.effect: It offers to remove the emotion forever in exchange for a treasured memory.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Starve the body
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Hollow' timer. At 4, the host collapses from starvation of will.

Parasite (Duke - Rank IV Demon).harm_levels: None while possessing (puzzle) — removed by starvation/discipline, not Harm.

Trow (Shadow Bargainer).summary: Enigmatic fey who keep to thresholds and almost-there spaces. Bound by courtesy.
locations: The space between departure and arrival
Trow (Shadow Bargainer).lore: Hint at an unnamed patron like the Gray Benefactor. They accept an honest memory as their due.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Name the toll
sb_spends.effect: It names a true memory as the price for safe passage.

sb_spends.name: [FEY] Threshold law
sb_spends.effect: It invokes threshold law; crossing without permission marks 1 Fatigue.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Test courtesy
sb_spends.effect: It provokes the rudest PC; an insult turns it hostile.

The Neighbors.summary: The forest's awareness of intruders, manifesting as silence and watching.
The Neighbors.lore: Manifest as an Oath-Keeper when a taboo is broken.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Forest falls silent
sb_spends.effect: All sound dies; the Neighbors become Dominant, the party Desperate.

sb_spends.name: [FEY] Invoke a taboo
sb_spends.effect: A PC breaks an unspoken rule; start a 4-segment 'Broken Promise' timer.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Eyes in the bark
sb_spends.effect: Eyes open in every tree; a PC cannot rest or recover while watched.

The Neighbors.harm_levels: None. Unkillable — a puzzle of attention and taboo, not a fight.

Hazel Queen's Emissary.summary: A fae courtier wearing leaves and law, bound by the Green Court's rules.
locations: Where the Hazel Queen's influence holds
Hazel Queen's Emissary.lore: Cannot lie but may omit. Any gift accepted creates a debt.

sb_spends.name: [FEY] The gift
sb_spends.effect: It offers a small gift; accepting binds a minor geas until repaid.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Riddle of leaves
sb_spends.effect: It demands a riddle-answer; a wrong answer costs the party a Boon.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Courtly alliance
sb_spends.effect: It offers Green Court support in exchange for a future favor.

Lady of Thorns.summary: Sovereign of a hawthorn court. She never lies; she simply doesn't need to.
Lady of Thorns.lore: Cannot be fought or bargained with on unequal terms. Offer a gift of equal value.

sb_spends.name: [FEY] Briar maze
sb_spends.effect: Hawthorn erupts from the ground, forming a maze of thorns.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Name her price
sb_spends.effect: She names an equal gift she desires; refusal turns the court hostile.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Honor guard
sb_spends.effect: Thorn Dryads arrive as her honor guard, blocking retreat.

Lady of Thorns.harm_levels: None. An Avatar-tier power — a puzzle of courtesy and equal exchange, not a fight.

Stone Giant.summary: A giant of living rock, found in mountain passes and under-vaults.
Stone Giant.lore: Pacified by a correct count of eight. Count to nine, and it will become hostile.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Hurl a boulder
sb_spends.effect: It throws stone; the terrain becomes difficult and a PC is knocked Prone.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Avalanche
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Avalanche' timer. At 4, rockslides sweep the pass.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Demand the count
sb_spends.effect: It bellows for a count; the wrong number enrages it.

Frost Giant.summary: A giant wrapped in permafrost, appearing during the deepest winters.
Frost Giant.lore: Driven back by a true fire, a hearth-fire that has burned for nine generations.

sb_spends.name: [ICE] Freeze the ground
sb_spends.effect: Its breath ices the earth; movement is halved in Near.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Blizzard
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Blizzard' timer. At 4, visibility drops to zero and cold deals Fatigue.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Demand tribute
sb_spends.effect: It demands fire or food; refusal provokes a charge.

Dream Giant.summary: A giant that appears in thin places and dreams, asking questions.
Dream Giant.lore: Banished by answering its question truthfully or by refusing to answer at all.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Ask the question
sb_spends.effect: It asks a riddle-question; a wrong answer marks 1 Fatigue.

sb_spends.name: [DREAM] Pull into sleep
sb_spends.effect: A PC who answers falsely falls asleep for one exchange.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Offer passage
sb_spends.effect: It offers safe passage if the party tells it a dream they never shared.

Promise-Eater Ogre.summary: An ogre drawn to broken promises, taking the memory of the broken promise.
Promise-Eater Ogre.lore: Can be satisfied by speaking the broken promise aloud, even if you don't remember it.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Speak the promise
sb_spends.effect: It demands the broken promise be spoken; silence worsens Position.

sb_spends.name: [MEMORY] Devour the vow
sb_spends.effect: It eats the promise; all witnesses forget it was ever made.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Name the one who owes
sb_spends.effect: It points at a PC and names them as one who owes; others must vouch for them.

Flesh-Ogre.summary: A huge, bloated ogre drawn to battlefields, scavenging the dead and living.
Flesh-Ogre.lore: Driven off by fire or a more appealing offering.

sb_spends.name: [BLOOD] Gorge on a corpse
sb_spends.effect: It devours a body, healing itself.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Upend cover
sb_spends.effect: It overturns a cart, wall, or barricade, exposing the party.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Offer a bigger meal
sb_spends.effect: It can be distracted by a larger or fresher offering.

Stone-Ogre.summary: An ogre covered in rocky hide, guarding places where the earth has been wounded.
Stone-Ogre.lore: Pacified by repairing the wound to the land.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Seal the passage
sb_spends.effect: It slams stone, sealing a doorway or tunnel.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Wound spreads
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Earth Bleeds' timer. At 4, the ground becomes unstable.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Mend the wound
sb_spends.effect: It pauses if a PC begins repairing the wounded earth.

Crater Oni.summary: A vast oni sleeping beneath a caldera, dreaming of waking.
Crater Oni.lore: Sealed by performing the old rites: a pilgrimage, a true name spoken at midnight.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] The caldera stirs
sb_spends.effect: Start a 6-segment 'Eruption' timer. At 6, ash and lava flood the area.

sb_spends.name: [DREAM] Dream-spawn
sb_spends.effect: The Oni dreams an Oni-spawn into being beside the party.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] The old seal weakens
sb_spends.effect: The binding rites falter; the Oni gains +1 die.

River Oni.summary: A clever oni dwelling in deep pools, offering bargains to the lost and desperate.
River Oni.lore: Driven off by a true name.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Offer what was lost
sb_spends.effect: It offers to return something a PC lost—for a future favor.

sb_spends.name: [TIDE] River rises
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Drowning Current' timer. At 4, the bank overflows.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Name the desperate
sb_spends.effect: It names a PC's secret desperation; that PC loses a Boon.

Dream Oni.summary: An oni that appears in dreams, offering bargains and taking memories.
Dream Oni.lore: Banished by speaking a truth never told or by waking.

sb_spends.name: [DREAM] Shared nightmare
sb_spends.effect: It pulls a PC into a shared nightmare; they act at Desperate until woken.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Rewrite the memory
sb_spends.effect: It offers to erase a bad memory in exchange for a good one.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Whisper while waking
sb_spends.effect: Its voice lingers after waking; a PC speaks a truth they meant to keep.

Goblin Scavenger.summary: Common pests in the Crown Spread, known for their greed and cowardice.
Goblin Scavenger.lore: Hunger's fingers. Can be bribed, threatened, or tricked.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] More pests
sb_spends.effect: Its shrieks summon 1d6 more scavengers.

sb_spends.name: [TRAP] Crude snare
sb_spends.effect: A hidden trip-wire or pit trap springs.

Tunnel-Goblin.summary: Pale, blind, and skittering goblins adapted to the darkness of the deep ways.
Tunnel-Goblin.lore: Navigate by echolocation. Weak to bright light.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Echolocation call
sb_spends.effect: Its clicking calls more tunnel-goblins from the dark.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Snuff the light
sb_spends.effect: It swarms a light source, risking breakage.

Ember-Goblin.summary: Goblins touched by the fires of Zahk'Kozahn, carrying the heat of Malachai's forge.
Ember-Goblin.lore: Explode in a burst of ash and heat when killed. Weak to water.

sb_spends.name: [FIRE] Ember burst
sb_spends.effect: A dying Ember-Goblin explodes, dealing Fatigue to all in Close.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Ignite the debris
sb_spends.effect: They set flammable material alight; the area becomes hazardous.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Forge-kin arrive
sb_spends.effect: The heat calls more Ember-Goblins from the cracks.

Sea-Goblin.summary: Webbed-fingered goblins that patrol the tide-lines, scavenging what the sea brings.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Tide brings more
sb_spends.effect: A wave deposits more Sea-Goblins on the shore.

sb_spends.name: [TIDE] Drag to water
sb_spends.effect: They grab at ankles, trying to pull a PC into the surf.

Star-Goblin.summary: Dust-gray goblins living in the high passes, their eyes reflecting constellations.
Star-Goblin.lore: Star-touched, leaving behind a glowing crystal shard when killed.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Crystal lure
sb_spends.effect: A dead Star-Goblin's crystal glows, drawing predators.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Starlight blindness
sb_spends.effect: Their eyes flare; a PC is blinded for one exchange.

Hobgoblin.summary: Taller, disciplined goblinoids acting as the Hunger's enforcers and sell-swords.
Hobgoblin.lore: Hunger's fist. Respect strength and order. Can be reasoned with from a position of strength.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Call the squad
sb_spends.effect: It blows a horn and 1d4 hobgoblins arrive.

sb_spends.name: [TACTICS] Flank and pin
sb_spends.effect: It orders goblins into flanking positions; the party's Position worsens.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Offer terms
sb_spends.effect: It will parley if the party shows clear dominance.

Mirk-Stalker.summary: Large, silent hunters of the goblinoid kind, patient and relentless.
Mirk-Stalker.lore: Hunger's stalker. Cannot be bargained with; can only be distracted or out-hunted.

sb_spends.name: [AMBUSH] Fade into shadow
sb_spends.effect: It vanishes and reappears behind a vulnerable PC.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Howl for kin
sb_spends.effect: Its hunting call brings a second Mirk-Stalker.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Mark the prey
sb_spends.effect: It wounds a PC without killing, marking them as quarry.

Fray-Hound.summary: Lean, wolf-like predators that patrol boundary edges, drawn to frayed balance.
Fray-Hound.lore: Hunger's reminder. Respond to imbalance, not aggression.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Sense imbalance
sb_spends.effect: It targets the most wounded or unbalanced PC.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Pack boundary
sb_spends.effect: More Fray-Hounds arrive at the edge of the boundary.

Earth-Shark.summary: A burrowing predator with a dorsal ridge like a plowshare.
Earth-Shark.lore: Something older that learned hunger from the sea and brought it to land.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Sinkhole
sb_spends.effect: Its passage opens a sinkhole; start a 4-segment 'Ground Collapse' timer.

sb_spends.name: [AMBUSH] Breach
sb_spends.effect: It erupts from beneath a PC, knocking them Prone.

Dust Hulk.summary: A wind-packed silhouette that rises from dunes, a memory given weight by thirst.
Dust Hulk.lore: Cannot cross running water. Spill water on its shadow to dissolve it.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Dust storm
sb_spends.effect: It whips sand, reducing visibility to Near only.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Thirst memory
sb_spends.effect: It shares its thirst; all PCs in Near mark 1 Fatigue.

Bone Kite.summary: A carrion bird with rune-etched pinions, feeding on the dying.
Bone Kite.lore: Can see the weight of unfulfilled promises. Accepts name-stakes as barter.

sb_spends.name: [OMEN] Circle the doomed
sb_spends.effect: It circles a PC, marking them as the next to fall.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Accept a name-stake
sb_spends.effect: It will carry a message if given a piece of a name.

Salt Screamer.summary: A pale eel in dry salt pans with a voice like a flute. Its scream is a question.
Salt Screamer.lore: Asks 'What is your name?' Answering truthfully grants a boon; lying advances its patience.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Ask the name
sb_spends.effect: It asks a PC's name. Lying costs a Boon; truth grants a Boon.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Patience ends
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Final Question' timer. At 4, it screams and deals Harm.

Phase Panther.summary: A shadow-striped cat that steps between gusts of wind.
Phase Panther.lore: Cannot phase through mirrored water. A silver mirror fascinates it.

sb_spends.name: [AMBUSH] Phase through guard
sb_spends.effect: It steps through a PC's defense and attacks from inside their guard.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Wind-stride
sb_spends.effect: It rides a gust, moving to Far in one exchange.

Lichen-Bear.summary: A moss-matted ursine with rock-teeth, carrying the memory of a lost forest.
Lichen-Bear.lore: Smoke of juniper calms it; salt enrages it. Burn the moss to kill it.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Spore cloud
sb_spends.effect: It shakes its moss, releasing spores; all in Near cough and take -1 die.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Memory of the lost wood
sb_spends.effect: A PC sees the forest it remembers and is Distracted.

Bramble Knight.summary: An empty helm grown through with thorn, a hedge that learned to walk.
Bramble Knight.lore: Cannot cross a line of salt. Accepts a hedge-blessing as safe passage.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Thorn barrier
sb_spends.effect: It grows thorns across a threshold, blocking passage.

sb_spends.name: [FEY] Demand the blessing
sb_spends.effect: It will not let anyone pass without a hedge-blessing or a line of salt.

Reef Serpent.summary: A kelp-maned constrictor nesting in pilings, a rope that forgot it was tied.
Reef Serpent.lore: Beat a drum in a rhythm it doesn't recognize to confuse it.

sb_spends.name: [TIDE] Coil the support
sb_spends.effect: It wraps a piling or mast; start a 4-segment 'Collapse' timer.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Kelp tangle
sb_spends.effect: It drags kelp across the deck, making movement Desperate.

Grave-Eel.summary: An eel that burrows through barrow loam and tastes names.
Grave-Eel.lore: A question that learned to wiggle. Feed it a false name to confuse it.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Taste the name
sb_spends.effect: It whispers a PC's name to the dead; the PC feels cold fingers on their grave.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Offer a false name
sb_spends.effect: A PC can feed it a false name to confuse it, but the dead remember lies.

Vein-Serpent.summary: A serpent of polished copper and malachite, swimming through stone.
Vein-Serpent.lore: The mountain's blood given form. Can be negotiated with to maintain the stone.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Stone flows
sb_spends.effect: It causes stone to flow like water, sealing a path.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Maintain the mountain
sb_spends.effect: It pauses if a PC offers to repair the stone it guards.

Wind Drake.summary: A rib-thin sky serpent that rides storm fronts.
Wind Drake.lore: Whistle back the storm to calm it. Ground it with a copper-weighted net.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Gust strike
sb_spends.effect: It kicks up a gust, knocking a PC prone.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Storm front
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Storm Worsens' timer. At 4, lightning strikes.

Rust Moth.summary: A swarm of iron-scaled moths that taste memory and rust metal.
Rust Moth.lore: Attracted to old keys. Repelled by a copper bell.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Swarm the light
sb_spends.effect: They swarm a lantern, dimming it.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Nibble a memory
sb_spends.effect: They taste a recent memory; a PC forgets one minor detail.

Lantern-Eye.summary: A floating orb of watchlight, jealous of secrets.
Lantern-Eye.lore: The dungeon's attention made visible. Offer a whispered truth to pacify it.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Demand a secret
sb_spends.effect: It bobs before a PC; refusal causes it to alert dungeon denizens.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Light calls watchers
sb_spends.effect: Its glow attracts other dungeon creatures.

Lantern-Eye.harm_levels: 8 (advanced); only Harm that bypasses "mundane weapons" counts against this pool.

Skeleton Knight.summary: Ancient guardians of forgotten tombs, often found in barrows.
Skeleton Knight.lore: Believed to be the remains of a fallen order of paladins.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Rouse the dead
sb_spends.effect: Its clatter awakens 1d4 additional skeletons.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Speak the old oath
sb_spends.effect: It speaks an old oath; a PC must answer truthfully or its blade finds them.

Thorn Dryad.summary: Fey guardians that are fiercely protective of old forests.
Thorn Dryad.lore: Connected to the Green Court and the Queen of Thorns.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Thorn eruption
sb_spends.effect: Thorns erupt from the ground in Near range.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] The forest answers
sb_spends.effect: A Bramble Knight or Treant stirs to aid her.

sb_spends.name: [FEY] Name the intruder
sb_spends.effect: She marks a PC as a trespasser; the forest turns hostile to them.

Slavering Hound.summary: Used by the Salt Prince's huntsmen to track fugitives.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Bay for the pack
sb_spends.effect: It bays; more hounds converge on its position.

sb_spends.name: [BLOOD] Mark the quarry
sb_spends.effect: Its bite marks a PC; all hounds gain Dominant Position against that PC.

Cultist Fanatic.summary: Devotees of the Drowned God, eager to die for their faith.
Cultist Fanatic.lore: Eager to die for their faith.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Martyr's call
sb_spends.effect: A dying cultist completes a ritual, summoning a Drowned One.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Ritual advances
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Drowned Rite' timer. At 4, the god's attention turns here.

Shadow Wraith.summary: Souls twisted by despair, lingering in the place of their death.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Wrap despair
sb_spends.effect: It cloaks a PC in despair; that PC acts at Desperate Position.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Shadows deepen
sb_spends.effect: The area dims; mundane light sources flicker.

Basilisk (Stone Serpent).summary: A serpent with a gaze that turns flesh to stone. Found in deep ruins and forgotten temples.
Basilisk (Stone Serpent).lore: The first basilisks were bred by the Astroegro as guardians. Their gaze is a curse that can be reflected by polished metal.

sb_spends.name: [STONE] Gaze lingers
sb_spends.effect: A PC who meets its eyes feels their limbs grow heavy; they are Slowed.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Petrification
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Turn to Stone' timer on a gazed PC. At 4, they are petrified.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Scatter reflectors
sb_spends.effect: It knocks over polished objects, making its gaze harder to avoid.

Chimera (Three-Fold Beast).summary: A monstrous amalgam of lion, goat, and serpent. Roams the wild places between kingdoms.
Chimera (Three-Fold Beast).lore: Created by a Lethai-thora flesh-shaper who sought to perfect the hunting beast. The original escaped and bred true in the wild.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] The goat calls
sb_spends.effect: The goat-head's bleat summons a second chimera.

sb_spends.name: [FIRE] Venomous flame
sb_spends.effect: The serpent head breathes flame and venom in a cone.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Territory marked
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Pack Arrives' timer. At 4, more chimeras contest the ground.

Cyclops (One-Eyed Giant).summary: A one-eyed giant of prodigious strength and simple appetites. Found in mountain caves and coastal cliffs.
Cyclops (One-Eyed Giant).lore: Distant cousins to the Stone Giants, the cyclopes were once servants of the volcano gods. They forge crude weapons from raw ore and eat whatever they can catch.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Hurl stone
sb_spends.effect: It throws a boulder, blocking a route and knocking a PC Prone.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Demand tribute
sb_spends.effect: It demands food or shiny things; refusal enrages it.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Forge a weapon
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Crude Forge' timer. At 4, its weapon gains +1 die.

Djinn (Desert Spirit).summary: A spirit of smokeless fire, bound to ancient lamps or hidden oases. Proud and capricious.
Djinn (Desert Spirit).lore: Older than the empires, the djinn were trapped by the first desert kings. They grant power to those who can earn their respect—or trick them into service.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Offer a wish
sb_spends.effect: It grants a small wish with a hidden, ironic price.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Sandstorm
sb_spends.effect: It whips the desert wind into a blinding storm.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Test of pride
sb_spends.effect: It poses a riddle of pride; a wrong answer costs a Boon.

Dragon (High Wyrm).summary: The eldest of the wyrms, wise and terrible. Only a handful remain in the world's deepest places.
Dragon (High Wyrm).lore: The dragons were ancient when the first elves carved their star-roads. They sleep in forgotten halls, dreaming of the age before mortal memory.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Dragon's Ire
sb_spends.effect: Start a 6-segment 'True Breath' timer. At 6, the Dragon uses its legendary breath.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Lair reshapes
sb_spends.effect: The Dragon's roar shifts stone; pillars fall and the hoard slides, changing the battlefield.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Offer a covenant
sb_spends.effect: It offers a pact: service in exchange for a single priceless gift.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Call the brood
sb_spends.effect: Its roar summons drake-kin to defend the lair.

Dragon (High Wyrm).harm_levels: 8 per phase (multi-phasic) — treat any elder dragon as a boss, per the Elder Dragon Template.

Gargoyle (Stone Watcher).summary: A living statue that guards rooftops and ruins. Motionless by day, predatory by night.
Gargoyle (Stone Watcher).lore: Forged from living stone by the Aeler, the gargoyles were intended as guardians. Many have forgotten their purpose and now hunt for sport.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Merge with stone
sb_spends.effect: It sinks into a wall or floor and disappears until it ambushes.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Sunrise approaches
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Sunrise' timer. At 4, it becomes invulnerable stone.

sb_spends.name: [AMBUSH] Drop from above
sb_spends.effect: It falls from a ledge onto a PC, knocking them Prone.

Gorgon (Fury of the Pale Shore).summary: A serpent-haired woman whose gaze brings death. Haunts the coastlines and salt-caves of the Amaranthine.
Gorgon (Fury of the Pale Shore).lore: The gorgons were once Sidhi priestesses who swore vengeance on the Ashaani slavers. Their curse was twisted by the Veiled Sisters, turning their fury into a petrifying gaze.

sb_spends.name: [STONE] Petrify an object
sb_spends.effect: Her gaze turns a nearby object to stone, creating cover or destroying gear.

sb_spends.name: [STONE] Limb stiffens
sb_spends.effect: A PC's arm or leg begins to harden; they take -1 die until cured.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Salt mist
sb_spends.effect: She exhales salt mist, blinding all in Near range.

Griffon (Sky Hunter).summary: A noble beast with the body of a lion and the wings of an eagle. Hunts the high peaks and open skies.
Griffon (Sky Hunter).lore: The griffons were once ridden by the Storm Kings of Ykrul. They remember the old alliances and sometimes offer their backs to those who speak the ancient tongue.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Carry skyward
sb_spends.effect: It grapples a PC and lifts them into the air.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Test of worth
sb_spends.effect: It challenges a PC to speak the ancient tongue; failure means aerial combat.

Harpy (Wind-Wraith).summary: A creature with the body of a bird and the face of a woman. Lures travelers to their doom.
Harpy (Wind-Wraith).lore: The harpies are said to be the ghosts of Linn women who drowned at sea. They sing to sailors, promising rescue, before leading them to the rocks.

sb_spends.name: [SONG] Lure toward rocks
sb_spends.effect: A PC must test Spirit or move toward the nearest danger.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Join the chorus
sb_spends.effect: More harpies arrive and their song becomes harder to resist.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Sea-mist
sb_spends.effect: Mist thickens; navigation and ranged attacks become Desperate.

Hydra (Many-Headed Serpent).summary: A serpent with multiple heads, each regrowing when cut. Dwells in the black lakes and deep fens.
Hydra (Many-Headed Serpent).lore: Born from the blood of a dying dragon, the hydra is a curse upon the land. Fire and acid are the only sure ways to prevent its heads from regrowing.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Heads regrow
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Regrow' timer. At 4, a severed head returns or a new one sprouts.

sb_spends.name: [BLOOD] Acidic blood
sb_spends.effect: Its blood splashes a PC, dealing Fatigue and corroding armor.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Spawn from blood
sb_spends.effect: A pool of hydra blood births 1d3 hydra-spawn.

Kraken (Tide-Terror).summary: A monstrous cephalopod that drags ships to the deep. Sleeper of the Amaranthine depths.
Kraken (Tide-Terror).lore: The kraken is older than the sea-faring nations. It sleeps for centuries, dreaming of the sunken cities of the Astroegro. When it wakes, the tides shift and the dead remember.

sb_spends.name: [TIDE] Tentacles around the hull
sb_spends.effect: Start a 6-segment 'Capsize' timer. At 6, the ship is pulled under.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Whirlpool
sb_spends.effect: The Kraken spins, creating a whirlpool that traps small boats.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Deep-spawn answer
sb_spends.effect: It calls sea-devils or reef serpents to swarm the decks.

Lamia (Serpent-Born Enchantress).summary: A creature with the body of a serpent and the torso of a woman. Preys upon the lonely and the lost.
Lamia (Serpent-Born Enchantress).lore: The lamiae were once priestesses of a forgotten moon goddess. Their transformation was a blessing that became a curse; they now consume the warmth of travelers to maintain their beauty.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Offer warmth
sb_spends.effect: She offers comfort and healing in exchange for a secret.

sb_spends.name: [SONG] Lure closer
sb_spends.effect: A PC must test Spirit or move into Close range with her.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Enchantment deepens
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Charm' timer. At 4, a PC is charmed and will defend her.

Manticore (Scourge of the Steppe).summary: A beast with the body of a lion, the wings of a bat, and the tail of a scorpion. Hunts the dry lands.
Manticore (Scourge of the Steppe).lore: The manticore was created by a Sky-Speaker who sought to punish a greedy Khagan. It now hunts across the steppe, its venomous tail a reminder of the cost of excess.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Tail spikes
sb_spends.effect: It launches venomous tail spikes, pinning a PC in place.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Blood calls blood
sb_spends.effect: The scent of blood draws a second manticore.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Venom spreads
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Venom' timer on a stung PC. At 4, they mark Harm 2.

Mermaid (Tide-Sister).summary: A creature of the sea with the upper body of a woman and the tail of a fish. Singers of the deep.
Mermaid (Tide-Sister).lore: The mermaids are the daughters of the Tide Father. They sing to sailors, not to lure them to death, but to share the secrets of the deep. Some say they carry the memories of drowned captains.

sb_spends.name: [SONG] Share a secret
sb_spends.effect: They sing a useful secret, offering a Boon for a price.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Rescue for a memory
sb_spends.effect: They offer to save a drowning PC in exchange for a memory.

sb_spends.name: [TIDE] Call a current
sb_spends.effect: They summon a current that moves the party or their boat.

Minotaur (Labyrinth-Kin).summary: A creature with the body of a man and the head of a bull. Dwells in mazes and under-mountains.
Minotaur (Labyrinth-Kin).lore: The minotaurs were bred by the Astroegro to guard their deepest vaults. They remember the old dungeons and pace the corridors of forgotten empires.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Charge the wall
sb_spends.effect: It smashes a wall; start a 4-segment 'Maze Shifts' timer.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Labyrinth rearranges
sb_spends.effect: Tick 'Maze Shifts' +1; at 4, the passages rearrange and a PC is separated.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Remember the old path
sb_spends.effect: It bellows in the old tongue; a PC sees the labyrinth as it once was and is Distracted.

Pegasus (Sky-Steed).summary: A winged horse of pure white, born from the blood of a dying star. Carries the worthy across the sky.
Pegasus (Sky-Steed).lore: The pegasus was the mount of the first Sky-Speaker. It appears to those who are lost and in need, offering a ride to safety—or to destiny.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Judge the worthy
sb_spends.effect: It judges a PC's heart; the wicked cannot approach.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Wing-beat dust
sb_spends.effect: It kicks up a blinding cloud of dust.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Carry for a promise
sb_spends.effect: It offers a ride to safety in exchange for a promise kept.

Phoenix (Fire-Born).summary: A bird of flame that dies and is reborn from its own ashes. A symbol of renewal and endurance.
Phoenix (Fire-Born).lore: The phoenix is said to be the first creature the Everflame created. It nestles in volcanoes, and its tears are said to heal any wound—or to ignite the spark of new life.
connections: The Oath of Flame and Light

sb_spends.name: [FIRE] Tears of flame
sb_spends.effect: Its tears heal an enemy or ignite the battlefield.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Rebirth
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Rebirth' timer. At 4, it immolates and returns fully healed.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Inferno
sb_spends.effect: The area becomes an inferno; all in Near take Fatigue.

Roc (Sky-Titan).summary: A colossal bird of prey that carries off elephants and dragons. Nests on the highest peaks.
Roc (Sky-Titan).lore: The roc is the oldest of the flying beasts. It remembers when the mountains were young and the seas were not yet salt. Its feathers are prized by kings, and its eggs are worth a kingdom.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Drop or snatch
sb_spends.effect: It drops a boulder or snatches a PC into the air.

sb_spends.name: [WIND] Wing-blast
sb_spends.effect: Its wingbeats knock prone all in Near.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Call its mate
sb_spends.effect: It screams; a second Roc arrives in 1d4 exchanges.

Sphinx (Riddle-Keeper).summary: A creature with the body of a lion and the head of a woman. Guards ancient secrets with riddles.
Sphinx (Riddle-Keeper).lore: The sphinx was created by the Lethai-thora to guard their most dangerous knowledge. It does not attack—it asks. The answer is always a choice. The choice is always final.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Pose the riddle
sb_spends.effect: It asks a riddle; wrong answer costs a Boon or advances a timer.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Knowledge for a secret
sb_spends.effect: It offers dangerous knowledge in exchange for a PC's secret.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Time to answer
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Riddle Timer'. At 4, the Sphinx attacks.

Troll (Boulder-Born).summary: A large, brutish creature of stone and flesh. Regenerates from almost any wound. Dwells in bridges and under-roads.
Troll (Boulder-Born).lore: The trolls were once Aeler builders who angered the mountain. They were cursed to become part of the stone they loved. Now they guard the places they once built.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Regeneration
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Regrow' timer. At 4, the Troll heals all Harm.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Tear up the bridge
sb_spends.effect: It rips up part of a bridge or path, isolating a PC.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Pay the toll
sb_spends.effect: It demands a toll; refusal means combat.

Unicorn (Silent Horn).summary: A horse with a single spiraling horn. A creature of purity and grace, shy of the wicked.
Unicorn (Silent Horn).lore: The unicorn is a creature of the Wilds that only appears to those of pure heart. Its horn is said to cure any poison, but it will only give it willingly—it cannot be taken by force.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Judge purity
sb_spends.effect: It turns from the wicked; an impure PC cannot approach.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Cure for a pure act
sb_spends.effect: It offers its horn's cure if a PC performs a selfless act.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Vanish into mist
sb_spends.effect: It fades into mist and reappears elsewhere.

Werewolf (Moon-Hunter).summary: A human who transforms into a wolf under the full moon. Cursed by their own rage.
Werewolf (Moon-Hunter).lore: The werewolves were once a tribe of hunters who angered the Wolf Spirit. Their curse is passed through blood; they cannot control their transformation, and they fear silver and the touch of holy ground.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Pack howls
sb_spends.effect: The pack answers; 1d3 more werewolves arrive.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Moon rises
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Moonrise' timer. At 4, all werewolves gain +1 die.

sb_spends.name: [BLOOD] Infecting bite
sb_spends.effect: A bite starts a 4-segment 'Curse' timer. At 4, the PC is cursed.

Wyvern (Rust-Wing).summary: A dragon-kin with two legs and a venomous tail. Smaller than a true dragon, but no less deadly.
Wyvern (Rust-Wing).lore: The wyverns are the remnants of the True Dragons' brood, scattered when the first wyrms fell. They nest on high peaks and guard old hoards with fiery jealousy.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Dive-bomb
sb_spends.effect: It stoops from above, knocking a PC prone.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Screech for kin
sb_spends.effect: Its cry brings a second wyvern to the fight.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Retreat to hoard
sb_spends.effect: It flees to its hoard to heal; start a 4-segment 'Hoard Defense' timer.

Kitsune (Nine-Tailed Fox).summary: A cunning fox spirit with the power of illusion and transformation. Found in the eastern realms.
Kitsune (Nine-Tailed Fox).lore: The kitsune serve as messengers between the mortal world and the Celestial Bureaucracy. Each tail is a century of wisdom; the greatest have nine tails and speak with the authority of the gods.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Trick for truth
sb_spends.effect: It offers a useful trick in exchange for a truth.

sb_spends.name: [ILLUSION] Mirror images
sb_spends.effect: It creates illusory duplicates; attacks against it become Desperate.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Wear a loved face
sb_spends.effect: It assumes the face of someone a PC trusts.

Naga (Serpent Sovereign).summary: A serpent-like being of divine ancestry, dwelling in rivers and deep pools. Judges of the waters.
Naga (Serpent Sovereign).lore: The naga are the children of Benzaiten, the river of words. They judge oaths sworn over water and punish those who pollute the streams. Their gaze is said to reveal all lies.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Judge the oath
sb_spends.effect: It tests a spoken oath; false oaths cost the liar a Boon.

sb_spends.name: [TIDE] Flood the chamber
sb_spends.effect: It raises water, flooding the area and forcing movement.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] River rises
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'River Rises' timer. At 4, the water reaches the neck.

Salamander (Fire-Born Spirit).summary: A spirit of living flame, found in volcanoes and deep forges. Dwells in the hottest places.
Salamander (Fire-Born Spirit).lore: The salamanders are the first children of the Everflame. They speak in embers and move through ash like water. Forge-masters seek them out for the heat of their presence.
connections: The Oath of Flame and Light

sb_spends.name: [FIRE] Ignite the floor
sb_spends.effect: It sets a flammable surface alight.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Melt stone
sb_spends.effect: It melts stone underfoot, creating hazardous lava pools.

Siren (Song of the Deep).summary: A creature of the sea whose voice enchants sailors to steer toward disaster.
Siren (Song of the Deep).lore: The sirens were once musicians of the deep court, bound to serve the Tide Father. Their songs are not malicious; they simply want company in the cold depths.

sb_spends.name: [SONG] Compel toward the deep
sb_spends.effect: A PC must test Spirit or move toward the water.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] The deep answers
sb_spends.effect: Sea-devils or drowned sailors surface to join her.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] A voice for rescue
sb_spends.effect: She offers to save a PC from drowning in exchange for their voice.

Sprite (Glimmer-Folk).summary: A tiny fey creature of light and mischief. Flitters through glades and shadows.
Sprite (Glimmer-Folk).lore: The sprites are the laughter of the first green things. They bear no malice, but they carry no loyalty—they serve only the moment's whim.

sb_spends.name: [FEY] Steal a shine
sb_spends.effect: They steal a small shiny object or a piece of jewelry.

sb_spends.name: [ILLUSION] Distracting lights
sb_spends.effect: They create distracting lights; a PC's next roll becomes Desperate.

Succubus (Dream-Thief).summary: A demon of desire that appears in dreams and offers pleasure in exchange for memories.
Succubus (Dream-Thief).lore: The succubi are the whispers of the Abyss, feeding on the warmth of mortal dreams. They drain their victims slowly, leaving them hollow and yearning.

sb_spends.name: [DREAM] Whisper in sleep
sb_spends.effect: A sleeping PC hears her offer and must test Spirit or lose a Boon.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Memory for pleasure
sb_spends.effect: She offers to remove a painful memory in exchange for a treasured one.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Hollow out
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Hollow' timer. At 4, a PC loses a memory permanently.

Tengu (Mountain Hawk).summary: A proud, winged creature of the high passes. Master of the sword and the riddle.
Tengu (Mountain Hawk).lore: The tengu are the guardians of the mountain shrines. They challenge travelers to duels of wit and steel, and they teach the most worthy the secrets of the old ways.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Duel of wits
sb_spends.effect: It challenges a PC to a riddle or blade duel; refusal shames the party.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Wind-crows
sb_spends.effect: It summons a flock of wind-crows to harass the party.

Tree-Keeper.summary: An ancient tree that has awakened to consciousness. Walks the forest and judges intruders.
Tree-Keeper.lore: The tree-keepers are the guardians of the green places. They remember the first forests and judge all who walk beneath their branches. They do not offer second chances.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Roots seize the ground
sb_spends.effect: Roots erupt across the battlefield, trapping all in Near.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Forest awakens
sb_spends.effect: Start a 6-segment 'Forest Awakens' timer. At 6, the whole forest turns hostile.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Promise to protect
sb_spends.effect: It pauses if a PC swears a binding oath to protect the green.

Vampire (Night-Lord).summary: An undead creature of the night, sustained by the life-force of the living. Cunning, patient, and ancient.
Vampire (Night-Lord).lore: The vampires are the remnant of a bloodline that refused to fade. They remember the old empire and wait for its return—or they build their own, one mortal at a time.

sb_spends.name: [BLOOD] Dominate the will
sb_spends.effect: A PC must test Spirit or obey a single command.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Summon spawn
sb_spends.effect: Lesser vampires or enthralled mortals arrive to serve.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Offer immortality
sb_spends.effect: It offers the Embrace in exchange for betrayal of an ally.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Blood frenzy
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Frenzy' timer. At 4, it attacks wildly with +2 dice.

Wight (Frost-Bound).summary: An undead creature of the frozen places, animated by ancient rage and forgotten hunger.
Wight (Frost-Bound).lore: The wights are the frozen dead of the northern passes, risen to guard the secrets of the ice. They do not negotiate—they only remember the cold.

sb_spends.name: [ICE] Drain warmth
sb_spends.effect: Its touch drains warmth; a PC marks 1 Fatigue.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Ice rises
sb_spends.effect: The frozen dead around it rise as lesser wights.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Endless cold
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Deep Freeze' timer. At 4, all in Near take Harm from cold.

Will-o'-Wisp (Fool's Light).summary: A glowing orb of false light that lures travelers into bogs and pitfalls.
Will-o'-Wisp (Fool's Light).lore: The will-o'-wisps are the spirits of those who drowned in the bogs. They lead others to join them, not out of malice, but out of loneliness.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Show false path
sb_spends.effect: It floats toward a pit or deep water; a PC must test Wits or follow.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Lead for a memory
sb_spends.effect: It offers to lead the way safely in exchange for a happy memory.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Bog claims
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Sinking' timer. At 4, a stuck PC is fully submerged.

Yeti (Snow-Stalker).summary: A great ape-like creature of snow and ice, dwelling in the highest peaks. Rarely seen, never forgotten.
Yeti (Snow-Stalker).lore: The yeti is a spirit of the mountain cold, older than the clans that revere it. Its howl is said to herald the arrival of the winter storms.

sb_spends.name: [ICE] Trigger avalanche
sb_spends.effect: Its howl triggers an avalanche; start a 4-segment 'Avalanche' timer.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Second howl
sb_spends.effect: Its call brings a second yeti from the whiteout.

sb_spends.name: [AMBUSH] Vanish into snow
sb_spends.effect: It disappears into the snow and ambushes next exchange.

Zombie (Unquiet Corpse).summary: A reanimated corpse, mindless and ravenous. Drives before it the scent of death.
Zombie (Unquiet Corpse).lore: The zombies are the broken shells of the dead, animated by necromantic impulses or the lingering residue of the Veil. They are little more than hunger and confusion.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] More dead rise
sb_spends.effect: Nearby corpses shamble to join the horde.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Horde grows
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Horde' timer. At 4, the mob becomes overwhelming.

Banshee (Scream of the Sidhe).summary: A wailing spirit that heralds the death of a clan's chieftain. Her cry is a memory of the old court.
Banshee (Scream of the Sidhe).lore: The banshee serves the Green Court, singing the names of the soon-to-be-dead. Those who hear her and survive are marked for a meeting with the Hollow.

sb_spends.name: [SONG] Wail of death
sb_spends.effect: All in Near must test Spirit or mark 1 Fatigue.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Death knell
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Death Knell' timer. At 4, a named PC is marked for death.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Name the next
sb_spends.effect: She names the next PC likely to die; that PC loses a Boon.

Tunnel-Grub.summary: A segmented, many-legged horror that dwells in the deep places, paralyzing prey with a touch.
Tunnel-Grub.lore: The tunnel-grubs were once carrion-feeders in the Astroegro vaults. The Deep Drake's pressure has twisted them, giving them a hunger for warm flesh.

sb_spends.name: [VENOM] Paralytic mucus
sb_spends.effect: Its touch leaves paralytic mucus; a PC is Slowed.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Grubs from cracks
sb_spends.effect: More grubs pour from wall cracks.

Strangle-Kin.summary: A small, rubbery creature with prehensile limbs that lurk in ceilings and drop onto unsuspecting prey.
Strangle-Kin.lore: The strangle-kin are the descendants of failed binding experiments. They cling to stone and shadow, their grip colder than the grave.

sb_spends.name: [AMBUSH] Drop from above
sb_spends.effect: It drops onto a PC and begins strangling.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Suffocate
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Suffocation' timer on a grabbed PC.

Cockatrice (Stone-Fowl).summary: A reptilian bird whose bite causes flesh to turn to stone. Roosts in ruins and rocky outcrops.
Cockatrice (Stone-Fowl).lore: The cockatrice is said to be hatched from a serpent's egg, incubated by a rooster. It does not hunt—it waits for the unwary to wander too close.

sb_spends.name: [STONE] Petrifying bite
sb_spends.effect: A bite begins petrification; start a 4-segment 'Stone' timer.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Flutter into the group
sb_spends.effect: It flutters into the midst of the party, forcing gaze checks.

Dire Wolf (Great Wolf).summary: A massive, intelligent wolf that hunts in packs. Revered by the Ykrul and feared by the lowlands.
Dire Wolf (Great Wolf).lore: The dire wolves are the descendants of the Wolf Spirit's first children. They are not beasts—they are hunters with a sense of honor that demands respect.

sb_spends.name: [TACTICS] Surround the prey
sb_spends.effect: The pack flanks the party, worsening Position.

sb_spends.name: [TACTICS] Harry the weakest
sb_spends.effect: They focus on the most wounded PC, ignoring others.

Shade-Strider.summary: A six-limbed panther wrapped in ghost-limbs of shadow-stuff. Its form shifts, making its true position impossible to fix.
Shade-Strider.lore: The shade-striders are the result of Lethai-thora experiments that blended shadow-stuff with predatory flesh. They never quite belong to this world.

sb_spends.name: [ILLUSION] Two places at once
sb_spends.effect: It seems to be in two places; attacks become Desperate.

sb_spends.name: [AMBUSH] Strike from shadow
sb_spends.effect: It vanishes and strikes from a PC's shadow.

Doppelganger (Face-Thief).summary: A creature that wears the faces of the living. It does not kill—it replaces.
Doppelganger (Face-Thief).lore: The doppelgangers are the spies of the Veiled Sisters, sent to infiltrate and destabilize. They are not assassins—they are collectors of secrets.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Replace an ally
sb_spends.effect: It slips away and returns wearing an NPC's face.

sb_spends.name: [ILLUSION] Borrowed face
sb_spends.effect: It briefly wears a PC's face, sowing confusion.

Mind-Reaver.summary: A creature of nightmare that feeds on the thoughts of the living. Hails from the deepest places of the world.
Mind-Reaver.lore: The mind-reavers are the remnants of a civilisation that predates the Astroegro. They do not speak aloud—they project their will. They do not attack with claws—they consume the self.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Psychic lance
sb_spends.effect: It projects pain; a PC loses a Boon and marks Fatigue.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Spare the mind
sb_spends.effect: It offers to leave a PC's mind intact for a secret.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Mind fracture
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Fracture' timer. At 4, a PC gains a permanent quirk.

Frost Wyrm (Ice-Breath).summary: A dragon-kin that breathes ice and sleeps in permafrost. Slower than its cousins, but no less deadly.
Frost Wyrm (Ice-Breath).lore: The frost wyrms are the guardians of the north. They remember the Winter Kings and demand tribute from all who cross their territory.

sb_spends.name: [ICE] Seal the door
sb_spends.effect: Its breath freezes a doorway or exit shut.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Blizzard breath
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Blizzard Breath' timer. At 4, it unleashes a freezing cone.

Sludge-Thing.summary: A transparent, cube-shaped ooze that glides through dungeons, digesting everything in its path.
Sludge-Thing.lore: The sludge-things are a byproduct of alchemical experiments gone wrong. They are mindless, relentless, and patient.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Block the corridor
sb_spends.effect: It expands to fill a corridor, blocking movement.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Digest gear
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Digestion' timer on gear it has engulfed.

Giant (Tall Folk).summary: Beings of immense stature, the giants remember the old world and the treaties that bound them to the earth.
Giant (Tall Folk).lore: The giants were once the rulers of the mountains, before the Aeler came. They keep the old oaths, but they do not forget the loss of their kingdom.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Kick a boulder
sb_spends.effect: It kicks a boulder into the party's path.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Recall the old oaths
sb_spends.effect: It demands the party acknowledge an old treaty.

Giant Spider (Weaver-Kin).summary: A massive arachnid with a web that can entangle a horse. Dwells in shadowed places.
Giant Spider (Weaver-Kin).lore: The giant spiders are the children of the Spider Queen. They weave not just webs, but memories and warnings.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Web the exit
sb_spends.effect: It webs a doorway, sealing it.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Spiderlings
sb_spends.effect: A swarm of spiderlings descends.

False Chest.summary: A creature that mimics the shape of treasure chests, doors, and furniture. Patient. Hungry.
False Chest.lore: The false chests are a mutation from the Astroegro era, designed to guard vaults. They are patient—they have been waiting for centuries.

sb_spends.name: [AMBUSH] Snap shut
sb_spends.effect: It snaps shut on a PC's arm or head.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Digest
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Digestion' timer on engulfed prey.

Stitched Horror.summary: A construct of sewn flesh and stolen sinew, animated by a spark of something forbidden.
Stitched Horror.lore: The stitched horrors are the legacy of the Lethai-thora's experiments. They do not serve—they are the leftover parts of a greater ambition.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Many voices
sb_spends.effect: It screams with the voices of its parts; PCs in Near mark Fatigue.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Assemble more
sb_spends.effect: Scattered body parts knit into a second horror.

Mummy (Veil-Wrapped).summary: A preserved corpse, animated by the remnants of its binding magic. Guards the tombs of ancient kings.
Mummy (Veil-Wrapped).lore: The mummies are the wardens of the old kingdoms. They do not attack those who show proper respect—but their patience has limits.

sb_spends.name: [CURSE] Cursed touch
sb_spends.effect: Its touch places a curse on a PC.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Curse spreads
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Curse' timer. At 4, the curse affects all nearby.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Awaken guardians
sb_spends.effect: It awakens more mummies from their sarcophagi.

Hollow-Steed.summary: A spectral horse of smoke and ember, ridden by those who have made a pact with the Hollow.
Hollow-Steed.lore: The hollow-steed is a creature of the Hollow's own making. It offers speed and power to those who are willing to pay the toll—a memory, a name, a breath.

sb_spends.name: [DREAM] Carry into the Ways
sb_spends.effect: It charges through a PC, carrying them a step into the Ways Between.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Speed for memory
sb_spends.effect: It offers escape-speed in exchange for a memory.

Ogre (Hill-Eater).summary: A large, brutish creature that feeds on the livestock and the lost. Dwells in caves and ruins.
Ogre (Hill-Eater).lore: The ogres are the distant cousins of the giants, but they lack the old wisdom. They eat what they can catch and break what they cannot.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Demand food
sb_spends.effect: It demands the party hand over rations or a captive.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Smash cover
sb_spends.effect: It smashes a wall or tree the party is using for cover.

Filth-Feeder.summary: A grotesque, tentacled creature that dwells in filth and sewage. Larger and hungrier than it appears.
Filth-Feeder.lore: The filth-feeders are the cleaners of the deep places. They are not evil—they simply eat what others leave behind.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Filth spray
sb_spends.effect: It sprays sewage, making the area hazardous.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Block the drain
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Flood' timer. At 4, the area floods with filth.

Thornfeather.summary: A creature of feather and fur, with the body of a bear and the head of an owl. Found in ancient forests.
Thornfeather.lore: The thornfeather is a creature of the old magic, born from a Lethai-thora experiment that was never undone. It hunts with silent patience.

sb_spends.name: [AMBUSH] Drop from the tree
sb_spends.effect: It drops silently from above onto a PC.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Deafening screech
sb_spends.effect: Its owl-head screech deafens all in Near for one exchange.

Fire-Spine.summary: A massive, insectoid creature with a blazing-hot spine. Burrows through ice and stone alike.
Fire-Spine.lore: The fire-spine is a creature of the deep cold, its heat a defiance of its frozen home. It hunts with patience and fury.

sb_spends.name: [FIRE] Ignite a PC
sb_spends.effect: Its blazing spine sets a PC's gear alight.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Melt the ice
sb_spends.effect: It melts ice underfoot, creating treacherous water.

Stone-Tongue.summary: A stalactite-shaped creature with long, sticky tendrils that drag prey into its mouth.
Stone-Tongue.lore: The stone-tongues are the oldest inhabitants of the deep places. They do not move—they wait. They have been waiting since the first stone was laid.

sb_spends.name: [AMBUSH] Drop from ceiling
sb_spends.effect: It drops onto a PC and wraps its tendrils around them.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Drag upward
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Consumed' timer on a grabbed PC.

Sea-Devil.summary: A fish-like humanoid that hunts the coastal waters. Savage, territorial, and never alone.
Sea-Devil.lore: The sea-devils are the children of the deep trenches. They do not trade—they take. They do not negotiate—they feed.

sb_spends.name: [TIDE] School flanks
sb_spends.effect: A school of sea-devils flanks the party from the water.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Deep one rises
sb_spends.effect: A larger deep one surfaces to lead them.

Sea Serpent (Tide-Wyrm).summary: A serpent of the deep waters, long as a ship and quick as a thought. Dwells in the open sea.
Sea Serpent (Tide-Wyrm).lore: The sea serpents are the dragons of the deeps. They are not evil—they are indifferent to the concerns of the land.

sb_spends.name: [TIDE] Coil the vessel
sb_spends.effect: It wraps the ship or boat; start a 4-segment 'Crush Hull' timer.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Dive and capsize
sb_spends.effect: It dives, rocking and potentially capsizing a small boat.

Shadow (Blight of the Unseen).summary: A creature made of darkness, born from a death that was never witnessed. Hungers for warmth.
Shadow (Blight of the Unseen).lore: The shadows are the remnants of the Veil, fragments of a binding that failed. They do not strike—they drain.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Attach to a shadow
sb_spends.effect: It attaches to a PC's shadow, draining warmth each exchange.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Shadow consumes
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Consumed' timer. At 4, the host PC is incapacitated.

Bog-Kin.summary: A creature of living vegetation and swamp matter, animated by old magic. Dwells in the deep fens.
Bog-Kin.lore: The bog-kin are the swamp's immune system. They do not attack without reason, but their patience is not infinite.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Muck in the eyes
sb_spends.effect: It throws muck, blinding a PC.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Bog swallows
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Sinking' timer. At 4, a PC is trapped in the bog.

Skeleton (Bone-Walker).summary: A reanimated skeleton, driven by old magic or the lingering will of its former self.
Skeleton (Bone-Walker).lore: The skeletons are the remnants of the unburied. They do not speak—they march. They do not rest—they wait.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] More bones rise
sb_spends.effect: Nearby bones assemble into more skeletons.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Speak from beyond
sb_spends.effect: It speaks a single warning that reveals a danger.

Cave-Breaker.summary: A creature of immense strength and strange power, with the ability to burrow and confuse.
Cave-Breaker.lore: The cave-breakers are the remnants of a forgotten age, their minds as alien as their forms. They are not enemies—they are obstacles.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Collapse passage
sb_spends.effect: It collapses a tunnel or doorway, trapping someone.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Cave-in
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Cave In' timer. At 4, the ceiling falls.

Gem-Eater.summary: A three-legged, three-armed creature that burrows through stone, seeking precious gems.
Gem-Eater.lore: The gem-eaters are the miners of the deep places. They do not attack without provocation—they are simply hungry, and the deep earth is their pantry.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Tunnel for gems
sb_spends.effect: It will tunnel a path if offered gems.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Undermine footing
sb_spends.effect: It burrows under a PC, causing the floor to give way.

Web-Spawn.summary: A fusion of Aelinnel and spider, born from a failed bargain with the green courts.
Web-Spawn.lore: The web-spawn were once Aelinnel who sought power from the Spider Queen. Their transformation was a punishment for their ambition—they are now hunters of the deep places.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Web the exits
sb_spends.effect: It sprays webbing, sealing exits.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Spiders descend
sb_spends.effect: A swarm of spiders descends to assist.

Land-Shark.summary: A massive, armored burrower that hunts through earth and stone. Leaves nothing but cracks and screams.
Land-Shark.lore: The land-shark is the earth's rage given form. It does not hunt for food—it hunts for the pleasure of breaking rock.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Open sinkhole
sb_spends.effect: Its passage opens a sinkhole under a PC.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Ground collapse
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Collapse' timer. At 4, the area caves in.

Nidhoggr's Brood (Corpse-Tearer Kin).summary: The spawn of the corpse-tearer, each a nightmarish amalgam of wyrm and shadow.
Nidhoggr's Brood (Corpse-Tearer Kin).lore: Nidhoggr's children are not born—they are carved from the mountain's memory. They hunger for the warmth of the world above.

sb_spends.name: [PRESSURE] Crush of Nidhoggr
sb_spends.effect: The pressure of the deep intensifies; all in Near mark Fatigue.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] The mountain remembers
sb_spends.effect: More Brood carve themselves from the stone walls.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Corpse-tearer's approach
sb_spends.effect: Start a 6-segment 'Nidhoggr Wakes' timer. At 6, the father stirs.

The Ravenous (Ghoul King's Brood).summary: The spawn of the Ghoul King—savage, intelligent, and always hunting.
The Ravenous (Ghoul King's Brood).lore: The Ravenous are the Ghoul King's own. They do not eat for hunger—they eat for the memory of warmth.

sb_spends.name: [BLOOD] Devour warmth
sb_spends.effect: A Ravenous feeds on a corpse, healing and gaining +1 die.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] The King sends more
sb_spends.effect: More Ravenous pour from the dark.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Hunger spreads
sb_spends.effect: Start a 4-segment 'Ghoul King's Hunger' timer. At 4, all dead in the area rise.

Lusca (Tide-Devil).summary: A many-tentacled horror of the deep, larger and more cunning than any kraken-spawn.
Lusca (Tide-Devil).lore: The lusca is the kraken's older, crueler sibling. It does not sleep—it waits, coiled in the darkness, its many eyes fixed on the surface.

sb_spends.name: [TIDE] Tentacles everywhere
sb_spends.effect: Tentacles seize the ship; start a 6-segment 'Drag Under' timer.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] Whirlpool
sb_spends.effect: The Lusca creates a massive whirlpool, trapping all vessels.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Eyes of the deep
sb_spends.effect: It calls abyssal spawn to swarm the decks.

Stone Giant King (Throne-Breaker).summary: The ruler of the stone giants, ancient and terrible. His voice is the sound of grinding mountains.
Stone Giant King (Throne-Breaker).lore: The Stone Giant King sits on a throne carved from the mountain's heart. He does not rule—he simply is, and the mountain obeys.

sb_spends.name: [ENVIRONMENT] The mountain obeys
sb_spends.effect: He commands stone; pillars fall and the ground splits.

sb_spends.name: [SOCIAL] Demand the old tribute
sb_spends.effect: He demands the party pay the mountain's ancient tithe.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Stone giants rise
sb_spends.effect: Stone giants break from the walls to serve him.

Frost Giant Jarl (Winter's Voice).summary: The chieftain of the frost giants, who speaks with the voice of the winter storms.
Frost Giant Jarl (Winter's Voice).lore: The Frost Giant Jarl does not negotiate—he commands. His word is the blizzard, and his silence is the frozen earth.

sb_spends.name: [ICE] Voice of winter
sb_spends.effect: He speaks a word of frost; all in Near take Harm from cold.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Blizzard gathers
sb_spends.effect: Start a 6-segment 'Whiteout' timer. At 6, the storm isolates each PC.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Frost giants answer
sb_spends.effect: His command calls frost giants from the whiteout.

Shadow Wyrm (Darkness Given Form).summary: A dragon of shadow and silence, born from the Ninth's first mistake.
Shadow Wyrm (Darkness Given Form).lore: The Shadow Wyrm does not breathe fire—it breathes forgetting. Those who face it may not remember why they came.

sb_spends.name: [SHADOW] Breath of forgetting
sb_spends.effect: It exhales shadow; all in Near must test Spirit or forget their current goal.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] Shadow consumes the story
sb_spends.effect: Start a 6-segment 'Forgetting' timer. At 6, the party forgets why they entered the dungeon.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Whisper from shadow
sb_spends.effect: It whispers a PC's forgotten sin, causing them to hesitate.

The Hollow King (Lord of the Forgotten).summary: The ruler of the Hollow itself—a king of shadows and promises that were never kept.
The Hollow King (Lord of the Forgotten).lore: The Hollow King is the echo of a monarch who broke a promise to the world. He does not rule—he waits, and his patience is a weight that bends the world.

sb_spends.name: [HAUNT] Name the unkept promise
sb_spends.effect: He names a promise a PC broke; they act at Desperate until they acknowledge it.

sb_spends.name: [BARGAIN] Offer to unmake a debt
sb_spends.effect: He offers to erase one of the party's debts in exchange for a name.

sb_spends.name: [TIMER] The Hollow closes
sb_spends.effect: Start a 6-segment 'Hollow Collapse' timer. At 6, the Ways Between swallow the party.

sb_spends.name: [REINFORCEMENT] Forgotten subjects
